All tapes are new, sealed, and unopened with clear labeling and product details on the cases.

Featuring a vibrant assortment of round cardboard POGs and several metal and plastic slammers, this lot showcases a colorful variety of fun designs, including cartoons, sports, holographic graphics, and bold patterns. Each piece is individually unique, capturing the energetic spirit of the 1990s playground craze. This collection contains a substantial number of caps and slammers, making it ideal for collectors, hobbyists, or anyone looking to relive classic game moments. The POGs and slammers exhibit evidence of regular handling, with some edge wear and minor surface scratches visible on certain pieces, which is typical for vintage game pieces played and enjoyed over the years. No original branding or manufacture year is shown, emphasizing a truly mixed assortment. Both storage tubes are included for convenient organization and display. A fantastic find for anyone wanting to expand their collection or introduce new players to this iconic game
